block.guhs.ringh6_kooislot.lore: Keeps a Smoke Guhling locked up. Click it to pry it open.
item.guhs.ringh6_stukje_knabbelring: Piece of the Fried Nibble Ring
item.guhs.ringh6_stukje_knabbelring.lore: Golden brown, crispy and a little bit everyone's. One nibble to share them all.
quest.guhs.ringh6.kamp.sam: There it stands, boss. Mount Fry. First a bite by the fire, then up we go. Nyeg.
quest.guhs.ringh6.kamp.smikagol: Up, up, the tasty path! Smikagol shows the way. Smikagol could carry the ring for a bit too? No? Pity.
quest.guhs.ringh6.kamp.hint: Follow the Winding Path behind the gate. Falling embers only shove you: watch out and keep walking!
quest.guhs.ringh6.kool.raak.0: Boink! An ember. It only shoves, nyeg.
quest.guhs.ringh6.kool.raak.1: Smack! Hot, but you're fine. Look up!
quest.guhs.ringh6.kool.raak.2: Ow! Oh wait, not ow. Just a shove.
quest.guhs.ringh6.kool.sam: Watch out, boss! The mountain is throwing embers!
quest.guhs.ringh6.slot.al_open: You've already freed this Smoke Guhling. It's probably waving somewhere above you, nyeg.
quest.guhs.ringh6.slot.eerst: This lock is stuck tight. First free the Smoke Guhling lower down the mountain.
quest.guhs.ringh6.slot.niet_van_jou: This isn't your adventure: this lock is waiting for a ring-bearer who is at this point in the story.
quest.guhs.ringh6.rookguh.vrij.1: Wahoog! Free! The Mikas used me as a range hood! If you need us, we'll come and get you!
quest.guhs.ringh6.rookguh.vrij.2: Free, free, free! My little sister is still higher up. I'll go fetch Mom and Dad, nyeg!
quest.guhs.ringh6.rookguh.vrij.3: At last! We're all together! Just call when the mountain starts to bubble, we'll come flying!
quest.guhs.ringh6.rookguh.zielig: The Smoke Guhling looks at you through the bars. The lock is on the front.
quest.guhs.ringh6.rookguh.sam: Poor thing. Well done, boss. Onward and upward!
quest.guhs.ringh6.rookguh.dank.1: Wahoog, ring-bearer! We just live here now. Without a cage. It smells like fries, nyeg!
quest.guhs.ringh6.rookguh.dank.2: Remember that flight home? Dad's muscles are still sore from it. Thank you!
quest.guhs.ringh6.rookguh.dank.3: The Mikas have bought a real range hood now. It doesn't work. We're laughing our tummies round!
quest.guhs.ringh6.touw.hint: The path ends here. Look up at the little blue lamp and right-click with the Elven Rope.
quest.guhs.ringh6.touw.sam: I can't climb with all these pans, boss. You go, I'll get there! (Don't ask how.)
quest.guhs.ringh6.touw.geen: You need the Elven Rope. Sam-guh still had one in his backpack: here!
quest.guhs.ringh6.smikagol.loer.0: The chonkie is getting so heavy... Smikagol will carry it for a bit. Hand it over. Give!
quest.guhs.ringh6.smikagol.loer.1: What's that shining in your pocket? Let Smikagol have a look... up close...
quest.guhs.ringh6.smikagol.loer.2: So tired, the little ring-bearer. Smikagol helps! Smikagol just takes the chonkie for a moment...
quest.guhs.ringh6.smikagol.mis: Almost! The chonkie slips away. Sssorry. That was a pet, not a pinch.
quest.guhs.ringh6.smikagol.duw: Smikagol grabs for the ring and shoves you aside!
quest.guhs.ringh6.smikagol.verblind: Ow! The light! It stings our little eyesss! Smikagol has stopped already!
quest.guhs.ringh6.smikagol.sam: Paws off, you sneak! Boss, flash him with the Light Phial if he starts again.
quest.guhs.ringh6.zwaar.half: The Nibble Ring tugs at your pocket. It gets heavier with every step.
quest.guhs.ringh6.zwaar.vol: The Nibble Ring now weighs as much as a whole cheese shop. You can barely move forward.
quest.guhs.ringh6.sam.draag: I can't carry the ring... but I can carry you, nyeg! Climb on my back, boss.
quest.guhs.ringh6.sam.nog_niet: The Smoke Guhlings first, boss. Then I'll carry you, promise.
quest.guhs.ringh6.sam.boven: There's the crack. From here it's up to you, boss. It's your nibble. I'm right behind you.
quest.guhs.ringh6.sam.hint: Click Sam-guh: he'll carry you up the last stretch.
quest.guhs.ringh6.rand.hint: Walk to the rim of the Frying Edge, above the fryer.
quest.guhs.ringh6.rand.geen_ring: You don't have the Nibble Ring with you. Click Sam-guh: he kept it safe for you.
quest.guhs.ringh6.stukje: You get your very own piece of the fried Nibble Ring. You may keep it. Or eat it.
quest.guhs.ringh6.thuis: The Smoke Guhs gently set you down in the Guhmension. They're already singing there: walk to the party!
quest.guhs.ringh6.thuis.ver: The party is waiting for you in the Nibble Shire: Guhdalf's camp by the big Barbecue Pit in the Guhmension, where your story began. Go there (the Super Compass shows the way: My Story). As soon as you stand on the ground there, the party starts.
quest.guhs.ringh6.feest.klaar: What a party. And from now on there's one every day, in the Nibble Shire.
gui.guhs.ringh6.doel.thuis: The party in the Nibble Shire
gui.guhs.verhalen.ring_h6.uitleg: The Nibble Ring has to go into the fryer. On top of Mount Fry, in the Smoke Delta. Sam-guh is coming along, and so is Smikagol. Sadly.
gui.guhs.verhalen.ring_h6.nu.0: Walk with Sam-guh to the foot of Mount Fry and find the base camp with the Rest Fire.
gui.guhs.verhalen.ring_h6.waar.0: Mount Fry in the Smoke Delta (Guhbarbecuether)
gui.guhs.verhalen.ring_h6.nu.1: Climb the Winding Path up to the First Ledge. Dodge the falling embers (they only shove) and click the lock on the cage to free the Smoke Guhling.
gui.guhs.verhalen.ring_h6.waar.1: The Winding Path, around the mountain
gui.guhs.verhalen.ring_h6.nu.2: The path has collapsed. Look up at the little blue lamp and use the Elven Rope on the hook, twice. Free the second Smoke Guhling. Smikagol grabs for the ring: flash him away with the Light Phial.
gui.guhs.verhalen.ring_h6.waar.2: The west face of Mount Fry
gui.guhs.verhalen.ring_h6.nu.3: Follow the narrow path to the east side, take the last hook up and free the third Smoke Guhling on the Third Ledge.
gui.guhs.verhalen.ring_h6.nu.4: The ring has grown too heavy. Click Sam-guh: he'll carry you the last stretch to the Crack of Fry.
gui.guhs.verhalen.ring_h6.nu.5: Walk through the crack to the Frying Edge above the fryer. It is time.
gui.guhs.verhalen.ring_h6.nu.6: The Smoke Guhs have brought you home. Walk to your friends in the Nibble Shire: someone is being crowned and there is a whole lot of food.
gui.guhs.verhalen.ring_h6.waar.6: The Nibble Shire, by the big Barbecue Pit (Guhmension)
gui.guhs.verhalen.ring_h6.nu.klaar: The Nibble Ring has been fried and shared. The Eye is taking a nap. Wahoog!
gui.guhs.verhalen.ring_h6.kort.0: Go to the base camp at Mount Fry
gui.guhs.verhalen.ring_h6.kort.1: Climb the Winding Path and free the Smoke Guhling
gui.guhs.verhalen.ring_h6.kort.2: Elven Rope on the hooks; free the second Smoke Guhling
gui.guhs.verhalen.ring_h6.kort.3: Last hook; free the third Smoke Guhling
gui.guhs.verhalen.ring_h6.kort.5: Walk to the Frying Edge above the fryer
gui.guhs.verhalen.ring_h6.kort.6: Go to the party in the Nibble Shire
scene.guhs.ringh6_frituur.aankomst: The Crack of Fry. This is where the Nibble Ring was baked. Well, almost: it was never fried.
scene.guhs.ringh6_frituur.gooi: There's the fryer, boss. Toss it in! ...It does smell good, nyeg.
scene.guhs.ringh6_frituur.twijfel: The ring is heavy. And warm. And it smells like fresh cheese nibble. Surely one little bite is fine?
scene.guhs.ringh6_frituur.niet_eten: Don't eat it! Fry it! That was the deal, nyeg!
scene.guhs.ringh6_frituur.gegrepen: Smikagol snatches the Nibble Ring right out of your paws!
scene.guhs.ringh6_frituur.dans: Oursss! The chonkie is oursss! Wahoog, wahoog, wah...
scene.guhs.ringh6_frituur.stil: Splash. It bubbles. It sizzles. It smells... pretty good, actually.
scene.guhs.ringh6_frituur.ach: Aw, poor sneak. ...Do you smell that too? It smells like the fair, nyeg.
scene.guhs.ringh6_frituur.krokant: PLOP! There he is again. Golden brown. Crispy. And glowing.
scene.guhs.ringh6_frituur.lekker: Look at that! The chonkie is crispy! And so are we! Smikagol has never been so nice and warm!
scene.guhs.ringh6_frituur.delen: It's far too big for Smikagol alone. Would... would you all like a piece too?
scene.guhs.ringh6_frituur.delen_sam: Sharing! That's it! One nibble to share them all, nyeg!
scene.guhs.ringh6_frituur.iedereen: Everyone gets a piece. It crackles. The greed melts away like cheese in the fryer.
scene.guhs.ringh6_frituur.oog: High above the crater, the Eye of Sauceron peeks inside. All this time he was only... hungry.
scene.guhs.ringh6_frituur.voor_oog: Here, big eye. For you. No more grumpy looks now.
scene.guhs.ringh6_frituur.oog_eet: Nom. The Eye blinks happily. Once. Twice...
scene.guhs.ringh6_frituur.dutje: ...and takes a nap. Zzz. The Guhbarbecuether is safe. And smells like fries.
scene.guhs.ringh6_vlucht.borrelt: Uh... boss? The fryer is boiling over! The whole mountain is going to bubble, nyeg!
scene.guhs.ringh6_vlucht.komen: Wahoog! We're coming to get you! With Mom and Dad!
scene.guhs.ringh6_vlucht.rookguhs: There they are: the Smoke Guhlings you freed. With their big, really, really big family.
scene.guhs.ringh6_vlucht.ook_mee: Wait for usss! Smikagol is a snack now, staying here is dangerous!
scene.guhs.ringh6_vlucht.naar_huis: Up, through the smoke, over the Smoke Delta. Back to the Nibble Shire.
scene.guhs.ringh6_feest.thuis: The Nibble Shire. It smells of grass, of fireworks and of a whole lot of food.
scene.guhs.ringh6_feest.welkom: There's our Ring-Bearer! Too late for breakfast, precisely on time for the party. Just as it should be.
scene.guhs.ringh6_feest.tweede: Is there a second party too? And a second dessert?
scene.guhs.ringh6_feest.stil: Shh, Pipp. First the crown. Then the dessert.
scene.guhs.ringh6_feest.kroon: Araguh, wanderer of the Sausage Woods: no nibbling on your crown before the end of the day. Long live the king!
scene.guhs.ringh6_feest.koning: My friends... you bow to no one. Except to the buffet, nyeg.
scene.guhs.ringh6_feest.tel: Forty-three nibbles I found along the way! Forty-three!
scene.guhs.ringh6_feest.tel_meer: Forty-four. I just took one off your plate.
scene.guhs.ringh6_feest.sorry: Sorry about that one time with the ring. I baked a cake. It's a little burnt.
scene.guhs.ringh6_feest.vis: Smikagol brought fishesss! Fried. Everything is tastier fried.
scene.guhs.ringh6_feest.naar_huis: Well, boss. We're back. ...Can I come live with you? I can cook, nyeg.
scene.guhs.ringh6_feest.einde: And they nibbled happily ever after. One nibble to share them all.
gui.guhs.verhaal.kaart.ring_h6.regel.0: Beyond the Black Grill Gate lies the Smoke Delta. And there, in the middle of the haze, it stands: Mount Fry.
gui.guhs.verhaal.kaart.ring_h6.regel.1: This is where the Nibble Ring was once baked. Well, almost. It was never fried, and that is why everyone wants to eat it.
gui.guhs.verhaal.kaart.ring_h6.regel.2: The plan is simple: climb to the top, ring in the fryer, done. Sam-guh brought pans for it.
gui.guhs.verhaal.kaart.ring_h6.regel.3: Smikagol is coming along too. He says he's helping. He's drooling a little. Nyeg.
advancements.guhs.knabbelring.ring_h6_be: Reach the base camp at the foot of Mount Fry
advancements.guhs.knabbelring.ring_h6_ro: Free the three Smoke Guhlings of Mount Fry
advancements.guhs.knabbelring.ring_h6_fl: Flash Smikagol away with the Light Phial when he grabs for the ring
advancements.guhs.knabbelring.ring_h6_ge: One Nibble to Share Them All
Watch the Nibble Ring get fried after all. And shared.
structure.guhs.frituurberg.tooltip: The volcano where the Nibble Ring must be fried (Guhbarbecuether, Smoke Delta)
